SELECT cls,
  CASE WHEN fished_date_doy < 60 THEN '1_lt60'
       WHEN fished_date_doy < 91 THEN '2_60-90'
       WHEN fished_date_doy < 121 THEN '3_91-120'
       ELSE '4_121+' END AS bucket,
  COUNT(*) AS n_trips,
  SUM(yt) AS tot_yt,
  SUM(anglers) AS tot_anglers,
  ROUND(SUM(yt)/NULLIF(SUM(anglers),0),3) AS ypa
FROM trips
WHERE fished_date_season = 6
GROUP BY cls, bucket
ORDER BY cls, bucket;
SELECT index_id, avail_season, avail_doy, value FROM climate WHERE index_id IN ('oni','pdo','mei_v2') AND avail_season=6 ORDER BY index_id, avail_doy DESC LIMIT 15;
